categories.main_business_segments: Chengdu Qinchuan IoT Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the IoT and smart city sectors, focusing on smart gas meters, smart water meters, intelligent sensors and related components, and industrial IoT. The company develops, manufactures, sells, and services IoT smart gas meters and related smart city IoT terminal products, as well as expanding into industrial IoT and intelligent sensor markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies including mechanical metering, shell sealing, temperature conversion, electronic metering, intelligent control, low power consumption, information security, and ultrasonic gas flow measurement. It employs integrated structural design and full-process manufacturing techniques, supported by an industrial IoT platform (QCINFMS) for digitalized smart manufacturing and quality control. The production includes automated smart gas meter assembly lines and in-house production of key components like aluminum meter casings.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large national and regional gas companies such as China Gas, Towngas, Kunlun Energy, and New Hope Group, as well as automotive and home appliance manufacturers for sensor products. The company serves the smart city infrastructure market, focusing on gas and water utilities, and is expanding into automotive sensor supply chains and industrial IoT applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with a nationwide sales and service network covering major cities and regions including Beijing, Shenzhen, Xi'an, Urumqi, and others. It also has limited overseas sales. Its subsidiaries are located in Sichuan (Meishan) and Chongqing.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qinchuan IoT operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sales of smart metering devices and sensors. It controls core component production and integrates upstream materials procurement with downstream product assembly and distribution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in IoT smart gas meters, smart water meters, intelligent sensors, and industrial IoT platforms. It emphasizes innovation in smart metering accuracy, safety, information security, and industrial digitalization. R&D investment increased to 19.4% of revenue in 2023, with over 200 new patents and participation in national standards development. The company also focuses on expanding intelligent sensor applications in automotive and home appliance sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of smart gas meters, smart water meters, intelligent sensors, and related IoT terminal products. The company uses a direct sales model supported by a nationwide marketing and service network. It also earns income from software and platform services related to smart city IoT management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Qinchuan IoT is one of the few domestic companies with integrated design and manufacturing capabilities for both gas meter base units and intelligent control modules. It holds a competitive position in China's smart gas meter market with recognized technology and brand advantages. The company faces competition in smart metering and sensor markets but leverages its industrial IoT platform and patent portfolio to maintain leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 327 million, a decline of 11.11% year-over-year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 59.2 million. The decline was due to market conditions and lower sales prices. The company’s total assets were about RMB 1.01 billion with net assets of RMB 690.7 million. R&D spending increased significantly, reflecting a strategic focus on innovation despite short-term profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qinchuan IoT emphasizes high-precision metering, integrated intelligent control, and robust information security in its smart gas and water meters. Its products feature advanced functions such as remote prepayment, real-time monitoring, safety cut-off, and data analytics, supporting smart city and industrial IoT applications. The company’s integrated manufacturing process and proprietary technologies ensure product reliability, cost-effectiveness, and compliance with international standards, differentiating it in the domestic market.
